product.label: Product on white
product.hint: For a product or object on a white or light plain background. Removes only the background that touches the edges.

signature.label: Signature or logo
signature.hint: For a signature, stamp or logo on white paper. Removes every pixel of the paper colour and keeps the edges sharp.

scan.label: Document or scan
scan.hint: For text or drawings on a paper scan. Removes the paper colour everywhere and keeps the ink.

portrait.label: Plain wall portrait
portrait.hint: For a person in front of a plain wall. Gentle, removes only what touches the edges and softens the cut. A shirt the same colour as the wall will lose parts.

screen.label: Green or blue screen
screen.hint: For a person or thing in front of a solid green or blue sheet. Tap the screen colour in the picture if the automatic one is wrong.
